```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .pa-hero { background: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d); color: #fff; padding: 2.5rem 2rem; }
  .pa-hero h1 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 2.2rem; margin: 0 0 .4rem; }
  .pa-hero p  { opacity: .7; margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }

  .pa-wrap { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem; }

  /* Sub-objective badges at the top of the page */
  .pa-tabs { display: flex; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .pa-tab {
    padding: .55rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: .82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    background: var(--map-bg-section, #f1f5f9);
    color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b);
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }
  .pa-tab.active { background: var(--map-red, #c9a227); color: #fff; }
  .pa-tab.pending { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }
  .pa-tab .pa-tag { font-size: .68rem; text-transform: uppercase; margin-left: .3rem; opacity: .75; }

  .pa-controls {
    display: flex; gap: .75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: end;
    padding: 1.25rem; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    box-shadow: var(--map-shadow);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .pa-controls .ctrl { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem; }
  .pa-controls label { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b); }
  .pa-controls select {
    padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    border-radius: 6px; font-size: .9rem; min-width: 160px; background: #fff;
  }
  .pa-controls select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--map-red, #c9a227); }

  .pa-status {
    padding: .75rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .88rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;
    background: rgba(201, 162, 39, .05); border-left: 4px solid var(--map-red, #c9a227);
  }
  .pa-status.error   { background: rgba(220, 53, 69, .08); border-left-color: #dc3545; color: #721c24; }
  .pa-status.pending { background: rgba(6, 182, 212, .06); border-left-color: #06b6d4; color: #0e5460; }

  .pa-summary {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: .75rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  }
  .pa-metric {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--map-shadow);
  }
  .pa-metric .val {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--map-red, #c9a227);
  }
  .pa-metric .lbl { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b); margin-top: .2rem; }
  .pa-metric .sub { font-size: .7rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b); margin-top: .15rem; opacity: .8; }

  .pa-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr; gap: 1rem; }
  @media(max-width: 900px) { .pa-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  #pa-map { width: 100%; height: 600px; border-radius: 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0); box-shadow: var(--map-shadow); z-index: 1; }
  @media(max-width: 768px) { #pa-map { height: 400px; } }

  .pa-card {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: var(--map-shadow);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .pa-card h3 {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem;
    margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d);
  }
  .pa-card canvas { max-height: 260px !important; }

  .pa-leader { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .85rem; }
  .pa-leader thead { background: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d); color: #fff; }
  .pa-leader th { padding: .5rem .6rem; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: .78rem; }
  .pa-leader td { padding: .45rem .6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0); }
  .pa-leader td.num { text-align: right; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: var(--map-red, #c9a227); }
  .pa-leader tbody tr { cursor: pointer; }
  .pa-leader tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(201, 162, 39, .04); }

  .pa-legend {
    display: flex; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;
    font-size: .78rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b);
    margin-top: .5rem;
  }
  .pa-legend .swatch {
    display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%;
    margin-right: .25rem; vertical-align: middle;
  }
</style>

<section class="pa-hero">
  <div style="max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Population and Access</h1>
    <p>Who each facility actually serves, and whether those people can realistically reach it.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="pa-wrap">

  <!-- Sub-objective navigation. Only #2 (Catchment) is live in Milestone A. -->
  <div class="pa-tabs" role="tablist">
    <span class="pa-tab pending" title="Coming next">1. Population-Facility Overlap <span class="pa-tag">soon</span></span>
    <span class="pa-tab active" aria-current="page">2. Catchment Population</span>
    <span class="pa-tab pending" title="Coming next">3. Physical Reachability <span class="pa-tag">soon</span></span>
    <span class="pa-tab pending" title="Coming next">4. Underserved Zones <span class="pa-tag">soon</span></span>
  </div>

  <!-- Controls -->
  <div class="pa-controls">
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="pa-country">Country</label>
      <select id="pa-country">
        <option value="tanzania" selected>Tanzania</option>
        <option value="kenya">Kenya</option>
        <option value="nigeria">Nigeria</option>
        <option value="uganda">Uganda</option>
        <option value="zambia">Zambia</option>
        <option value="malawi">Malawi</option>
        <option value="botswana">Botswana</option>
        <option value="ethiopia">Ethiopia</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="pa-radius">Catchment radius</label>
      <select id="pa-radius">
        <option value="pop_5km" selected>5 km</option>
        <option value="pop_10km">10 km</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="pa-status" id="pa-status">Loading catchment data…</div>

  <!-- Metric strip -->
  <div class="pa-summary" id="pa-summary"></div>

  <!-- Map + leaderboards -->
  <div class="pa-grid">
    <div>
      <div id="pa-map"></div>
      <div class="pa-legend" id="pa-legend"></div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="pa-card">
        <h3>Distribution of catchment size</h3>
        <canvas id="pa-hist"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="pa-card">
        <h3>Top 10 most burdened</h3>
        <table class="pa-leader"><thead><tr><th>Facility</th><th>Region</th><th style="text-align:right;">People</th></tr></thead><tbody id="pa-top"></tbody></table>
      </div>
      <div class="pa-card">
        <h3>Top 10 least utilised</h3>
        <table class="pa-leader"><thead><tr><th>Facility</th><th>Region</th><th style="text-align:right;">People</th></tr></thead><tbody id="pa-bottom"></tbody></table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var CATCHMENT_BASE = 'data/population/processed';
  var COUNTRIES = {
    tanzania: { label:'Tanzania', bounds:[[-11.8,29.2],[-1.0,40.6]] },
    kenya:    { label:'Kenya',    bounds:[[-4.7, 33.9],[ 5.5,41.9]] },
    nigeria:  { label:'Nigeria',  bounds:[[ 4.0,  2.7],[14.0,14.7]] },
    uganda:   { label:'Uganda',   bounds:[[-1.5, 29.5],[ 4.3,35.1]] },
    zambia:   { label:'Zambia',   bounds:[[-18.1,21.9],[-8.2,33.7]] },
    malawi:   { label:'Malawi',   bounds:[[-17.2,32.6],[-9.3,36.0]] },
    botswana: { label:'Botswana', bounds:[[-27.0,19.9],[-17.7,29.4]] },
    ethiopia: { label:'Ethiopia', bounds:[[ 3.0, 33.0],[15.0,48.0]] }
  };

  // Quintile-style palette for burden classes (green = light, red = heavy).
  var BURDEN_STEPS = [
    { max: 1000,    color:'#22c55e', label:'< 1 k' },
    { max: 5000,    color:'#84cc16', label:'1–5 k' },
    { max: 25000,   color:'#eab308', label:'5–25 k' },
    { max: 100000,  color:'#f97316', label:'25–100 k' },
    { max: Infinity,color:'#dc2626', label:'100 k+' }
  ];
  function burdenColor(v){
    for (var i = 0; i < BURDEN_STEPS.length; i++) if (v < BURDEN_STEPS[i].max) return BURDEN_STEPS[i].color;
    return BURDEN_STEPS[BURDEN_STEPS.length-1].color;
  }
  function burdenRadius(v){
    if (v < 1000)   return 3;
    if (v < 5000)   return 5;
    if (v < 25000)  return 7;
    if (v < 100000) return 9;
    return 12;
  }
  function fmt(n){
    if (n == null || !isFinite(n)) return '—';
    if (n >= 1e6) return (n/1e6).toFixed(1) + ' M';
    if (n >= 1e3) return (n/1e3).toFixed(1) + ' k';
    return String(Math.round(n));
  }
  function fmtFull(n){ return (n == null || !isFinite(n)) ? '—' : Math.round(n).toLocaleString(); }

  var map = L.map('pa-map').setView([-6, 35], 5);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png',{
    attribution:'&copy; OpenStreetMap &copy; CARTO', maxZoom: 12
  }).addTo(map);
  var facilityLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  var histChart;

  function setStatus(msg, kind){
    var el = document.getElementById('pa-status');
    el.className = 'pa-status' + (kind ? ' ' + kind : '');
    el.innerHTML = msg;
  }

  function renderLegend(){
    var html = '<span style="font-weight:600;color:#0a1628;">Catchment size:</span> ';
    html += BURDEN_STEPS.map(function(s){
      return '<span><span class="swatch" style="background:' + s.color + '"></span>' + s.label + '</span>';
    }).join('');
    document.getElementById('pa-legend').innerHTML = html;
  }
  renderLegend();

  function renderSummary(rows, col){
    var vals = rows.map(function(r){ return +r[col]; }).filter(isFinite);
    vals.sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
    var total = vals.reduce(function(a,b){ return a + b; }, 0);
    var median = vals.length ? vals[Math.floor(vals.length/2)] : 0;
    var max    = vals.length ? vals[vals.length-1] : 0;
    var min    = vals.length ? vals[0] : 0;
    // "Undserserved" quick metric: facilities serving < 500 people.
    var thin   = vals.filter(function(v){ return v < 500; }).length;
    document.getElementById('pa-summary').innerHTML =
      '<div class="pa-metric"><div class="val">'+ rows.length.toLocaleString() +'</div><div class="lbl">Facilities</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric"><div class="val">'+ fmt(median) +'</div><div class="lbl">Median catchment</div><div class="sub">' + fmtFull(median) + ' people</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric"><div class="val">'+ fmt(max)    +'</div><div class="lbl">Most burdened</div><div class="sub">people at 1 facility</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric"><div class="val">'+ fmt(min)    +'</div><div class="lbl">Least utilised</div><div class="sub">people at 1 facility</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric"><div class="val">'+ thin.toLocaleString() +'</div><div class="lbl">Under 500 people</div><div class="sub">very low catchment</div></div>';
  }

  function renderMap(rows, col, country){
    facilityLayer.clearLayers();
    if (!rows.length) { map.fitBounds(country.bounds); return; }
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      var lat = +r.latitude, lon = +r.longitude, v = +r[col];
      if (!isFinite(lat) || !isFinite(lon)) return;
      var m = L.circleMarker([lat, lon], {
        radius: burdenRadius(v),
        color: burdenColor(v), weight: 1,
        fillColor: burdenColor(v), fillOpacity: 0.75
      }).bindPopup(
        '<div style="min-width:200px;">' +
          '<strong>' + (r.facility_name || '—') + '</strong><br/>' +
          '<span style="color:#666;">Type: </span>' + (r.facility_type || '—') + '<br/>' +
          '<span style="color:#666;">Region: </span>' + (r.admin1 || r.admin2 || '—') + '<br/>' +
          '<hr style="margin:0.4rem 0;border-color:#eee;"/>' +
          '<strong style="color:#c9a227;">' + fmtFull(v) + ' people</strong> within ' + (col === 'pop_10km' ? '10 km' : '5 km') +
        '</div>'
      );
      facilityLayer.addLayer(m);
    });
    map.fitBounds(country.bounds);
  }

  function renderHistogram(rows, col){
    var vals = rows.map(function(r){ return +r[col]; }).filter(isFinite);
    if (histChart) histChart.destroy();
    if (!vals.length) return;
    // Log-scale-ish bins so a few Muhimbili-sized outliers don't flatten the rest.
    var bins   = [0, 500, 2000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000, Infinity];
    var labels = ['<500', '500-2k', '2-5k', '5-10k', '10-25k', '25-50k', '50-100k', '100k+'];
    var counts = labels.map(function(){ return 0; });
    vals.forEach(function(v){
      for (var i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) if (v < bins[i+1]) { counts[i]++; return; }
    });
    var colors = ['#22c55e','#22c55e','#84cc16','#eab308','#eab308','#f97316','#f97316','#dc2626'];
    histChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('pa-hist'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: counts, backgroundColor: colors, borderRadius: 3 }] },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx){ return ctx.parsed.y + ' facilities'; } } } },
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { font: { size: 10 } } },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { font: { size: 10 } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function renderLeaders(rows, col){
    var sorted = rows.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (+b[col]) - (+a[col]); });
    function row(r){
      return '<tr onclick="paZoom(' + r.latitude + ',' + r.longitude + ')">' +
        '<td>' + (r.facility_name || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (r.admin1 || r.admin2 || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + fmtFull(+r[col]) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }
    document.getElementById('pa-top').innerHTML    = sorted.slice(0, 10).map(row).join('');
    document.getElementById('pa-bottom').innerHTML = sorted.slice(-10).reverse().map(row).join('');
  }

  window.paZoom = function(lat, lon){
    map.setView([lat, lon], 12);
    facilityLayer.eachLayer(function(m){
      var ll = m.getLatLng && m.getLatLng();
      if (ll && Math.abs(ll.lat - lat) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(ll.lng - lon) < 1e-6 && m.openPopup) m.openPopup();
    });
  };

  var cache = {};

  function loadCountry(slug){
    var country = COUNTRIES[slug];
    if (!country) return;
    var col = document.getElementById('pa-radius').value;

    if (cache[slug]) { render(cache[slug], col, country); return; }

    setStatus('Loading catchment data for <strong>' + country.label + '</strong>…');
    var url = CATCHMENT_BASE + '/' + slug + '_catchments.csv';
    Papa.parse(url, {
      download: true, header: true, skipEmptyLines: true,
      complete: function(res){
        var rows = (res.data || []).filter(function(r){
          return r.facility_code && r.latitude && r.longitude &&
                 (r.pop_5km != null || r.pop_10km != null);
        });
        if (rows.length === 0) {
          setStatus(
            '<strong>Catchment data not yet available for ' + country.label + '.</strong> ' +
            'This layer needs a one-off pipeline run &mdash; see <code>scripts/population/README.md</code>. ' +
            'The map + charts will populate once <code>data/population/processed/' + slug + '_catchments.csv</code> is committed.',
            'pending'
          );
          facilityLayer.clearLayers();
          document.getElementById('pa-summary').innerHTML = '';
          document.getElementById('pa-top').innerHTML = '';
          document.getElementById('pa-bottom').innerHTML = '';
          if (histChart) histChart.destroy();
          map.fitBounds(country.bounds);
          return;
        }
        cache[slug] = rows;
        render(rows, col, country);
      },
      error: function(err){
        setStatus('Could not load ' + url + '. ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : ''), 'error');
      }
    });
  }

  function render(rows, col, country){
    setStatus(
      '<strong>' + rows.length.toLocaleString() + '</strong> facilities in ' + country.label +
      '. Marker size &amp; colour show population within ' + (col === 'pop_10km' ? '10 km' : '5 km') + '.',
      ''
    );
    renderSummary(rows, col);
    renderMap(rows, col, country);
    renderHistogram(rows, col);
    renderLeaders(rows, col);
  }

  document.getElementById('pa-country').addEventListener('change', function(){
    loadCountry(this.value);
  });
  document.getElementById('pa-radius').addEventListener('change', function(){
    loadCountry(document.getElementById('pa-country').value);
  });

  loadCountry('tanzania');
})();
</script>
```
